Aidoc is the market leader in healthcare AI and has developed the world's largest clinical frontier model, supporting nearly 50 million patients each year.

title: מנהל/ת איכות בפרויקטים
description:
מנהל/ת איכות בפרויקטים
נתב"ג
קצת על התפקיד
למפעל הסבות והשבחות בחטיבת תעופה דרוש/ה מנהל/ת איכות פרויקטים.
התפקיד כולל:
• שותפות בכירה בצוות הפרויקט הכולל אחריות על כלל הנושאים הקשורים לאיכות בשלבי הפיתוח ,הניסויים, היצור, האספקה ותמיכה בלקוח בפרויקטים השונים.
• הובלת טיפול בנושאי איכות, לרבות ייזום ומתן פתרונות לבעיות איכות וקביעת מדדים ושיטות בקרה מותאמות, ניתוח תוצאות וייזום פעילות מתקנת.
• השתתפות בסקרי התכן השונים, הגדרת דרישות האיכות ברמות השונות של הפרויקט ומעקב אחר ביצוען.
• מעורבות בתהליכי הוכחת התכן והוכחת הכושר של המערכות בפרויקט.
• הובלת פעילות האיכות בפרויקט ואצל קבלני המשנה, כולל ביצוע סיקורים פנימיים ותחקירים.
• להוות POC מול גורמי ניהול האיכות של הלקוח וקבלני המשנה.
מה אנחנו מחפשים
• תואר ראשון בהנדסת מכונות \חומרים\ אווירונאוטיקה \תעשייה וניהול – חובה
• ניסיון מוכח של 5 שנים לפחות כמנהל/ת איכות או מהנדס/ת איכות- חובה
• עבודה מול לקוחות וקבלני משנה בארץ ו/או בחו"ל- חובה
• בקיאות והיכרות עם תקני איכות AS9100\ISO9000- חובה
• יכולת עבודה בניהול מטריציוני
• ניסיון בתחום התעופתי וניסיון בעבודה מול חיל האוויר- יתרון
• מהנדס איכות\CQE - יתרון
• שליטה טובה מאוד בשפה האנגלית (דיבור, קריאה וכתיבה)
אולי יעניין אותך לדעת
כחברה מובילה בעולם בתחום תעופה וחלל, קבוצת התעופה של התעשייה האווירית מעורבת בכל ההיבטים של תעשיית התעופה, החל בתכנון ובפיתוח, דרך הנדסה וייצור של מבנים תעופתיים ומטוסים שלמים, וכלה בבדיקות ובאישורים. בנוסף, קבוצת התעופה מעניקה שירותי תחזוקה מקיפים ואיכותיים לכלי טיס, מנועים ורכיבים, תחת קורת גג אחת. שירותים אלה כוללים תחזוקה כבדה, שינויים ושיפורים, שדרוגי מטוסים אזרחיים וצבאיים, וכן את השירות המוביל בעולם, עם למעלה מ-45 שנות ניסיון, להסבת מטוסי נוסעים למטוסי מטען.
הנדסה ופיתוח

.
Description
Work one day per week, from approximately 12:00 p.m. through the evening, to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams during U.S. business hours.
About the Role
We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented
to join our Legal team in Israel. This is an individual-contributor role supporting the Legal team’s day-to-day operations and working closely with business partners in Israel and the United States. The role focuses on legal workflows, contract administration, systems, reporting, project coordination, and the continuous improvement of Legal team processes. This position does not require admission to the bar or an active license to practice law. However, candidates must hold a bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B. or equivalent) or have hands-on legal experience.
You Will
Full time position, Work one day per week, from approximately 12:00 p.m. through the evening, to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams during U.S. business hours.
Coordinate the full contract lifecycle, including intake, initial document review, internal approvals, signature, filing, and ongoing tracking.
Review legal documents, conduct legal research, and support the preparation and drafting of routine legal materials.
Track open matters, deadlines, approvals, renewals, and action items, and follow up with relevant stakeholders.
Maintain accurate and organized legal records, contract repositories, templates, and knowledge-management resources.
Manage and continuously improve legal workflows, processes, and systems to increase efficiency, consistency, and visibility.
Administer contract-management, e-signature, document-management, e-billing, and other legal platforms.
Use AI-powered tools and legal technology to support contract review, research, document drafting, workflow automation, and knowledge management.
Coordinate legal projects and collaborate with internal stakeholders across Legal, Finance, HR, Sales, Operations, and other business teams in Israel and the United States.
Prepare reports, spreadsheets, dashboards, and operational data to support planning and decision-making within the Legal team.

title: Total Rewards Analyst - Temporary Position (3 months)
description:
Company Description
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation. Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen. This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems. We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture. What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely. If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
Job Description
About the Role Numbers tell stories. Compensation tells even better stories. We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Compensation & Benefits Analyst to join our Global Compensation & Benefits team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who loves working with data, enjoys solving puzzles, and wants to learn how global organizations make decisions about employee pay, benefits, rewards, and workforce strategy. You don't need to be a compensation expert yet - we will teach you that part. What we're really looking for is someone who gets excited about Excel formulas, asks "why?" more often than most people, and isn't afraid to dive into large datasets until they reveal their secrets. (Warning: prolonged exposure to this role may result in unexpectedly strong opinions about salary structures, market data, and pivot tables.) What You'll Do As part of our Global Compensation & Benefits team, you will: Compensation Analytics & Benchmarking Participate in salary benchmarking projects using leading market surveys and compensation databases. Analyze internal and external compensation data to support competitive and equitable pay decisions. Assist with the maintenance of salary ranges, job architecture, and compensation frameworks. Support annual compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, and salary adjustments. Conduct compensation analyses and help prepare recommendations for managers and HR partners. Data, Reporting & Insights Partner with HR Operations on data management in the HR system (HRDB) - including uploads, audits, and ongoing maintenance of HR data - to safeguard data integrity across the employee lifecycle. Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and analyses using Excel, Power BI, and HR systems. Translate complex data into simple and actionable insights. Support pay equity, workforce planning, and regulatory reporting initiatives. Benefits & Total Rewards Assist in the evaluation and administration of employee benefits programs. Conduct market research and trend analysis on benefits and total rewards practices. Support communication efforts to help employees understand our rewards programs. Business Partnership Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders on compensation-related initiatives. Contribute to projects that improve processes, governance, and the employee experience. Continuous Improvement Look for smarter, faster, and more efficient ways to work. Leverage AI and technology tools to enhance reporting, analyses, and decision-making. Bring fresh ideas and challenge existing assumptions. This is a temporary position for 3 months
Qualifications
Required Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Business Administration, Human Resources, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Advanced Excel skills or a strong willingness to become an Excel wizard. High attention to detail and strong organizational skills. Excellent communication skills in English. Curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset. Nice to Have Familiarity with compensation, benefits, finance, payroll, or HR analytics. Experience using AI tools to improve productivity and analysis. Basic knowledge of statistics and data visualization. Who Will Thrive in This Role? You might be a great fit if: You enjoy working with numbers as much as people. You get genuine satisfaction from finding an error that nobody else noticed. You ask thoughtful questions instead of accepting things at face value. You can explain a complicated analysis in language that normal humans understand. You view "I've never done that before" as an exciting opportunity rather than a problem. What You'll Learn This role offers a unique opportunity to build expertise in: Global compensation strategy Salary benchmarking and market intelligence Pay equity and regulatory compliance Executive and broad-based compensation programs Benefits design and governance Advanced people analytics Business partnering and stakeholder management You'll work closely with experienced Compensation & Benefits professionals and gain exposure to strategic projects that have a direct impact on thousands of employees worldwide. Final Note We're not looking for someone who already knows everything about Compensation & Benefits. We're looking for someone who is excited to learn everything about Compensation & Benefits. If you're naturally curious, analytical, driven, and ready to grow - we'd love to meet you. Bring your curiosity. We'll teach you the compensation part.
Additional Information

description:
Who Connecteam is:
Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.
We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other.
Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.
Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.
About The Role
Connecteam is looking for a product-first, AI-native Data Analyst to shape how our Product organization understands signup, activation, feature adoption, and launches.
This is a high-ownership role combining strong business judgment with deep technical capabilities. You will contribute to strategic initiatives, work closely with Product Managers, engineers, and senior leadership, and help shape how decisions are made across the company.
You will work primarily with dbt, BigQuery, Looker, and GitHub, using AI-enabled tools such as Cursor, MCP integrations, n8n, and OpenClaw to accelerate and automate your work.
For us, AI-native means more than generating SQL in a chatbot. It means giving agents the right context and tools, validating their output, and turning repeatable processes into reusable workflows.
Product data is consumed throughout Connecteam. Success in this role therefore requires excellent communication, proactive ownership, and the ability to translate complex analysis into practical business recommendations.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with Product Managers and engineers to define events, funnels, activation criteria, adoption metrics, and post-launch measurement.
Analyze high-impact questions involving signup conversion, first-day behavior, feature adoption, retention, and release performance.
Contribute to strategic projects and provide leadership with trusted insights and actionable recommendations.
Define and validate analytics events, then integrate them into our usage, 360, and feature-usage models.
Extend and validate dbt models, owning changes through pull request and CI.
Build and maintain focused Looker dashboards that support product decisions.
Investigate anomalies, usage drops, tracking failures, spam, and inconsistent metrics.
Turn repeatable analyses and operational processes into agent skills, rules, and automated workflows.
Experience & Skills
3+ years of experience in product or growth analytics within a fast-paced SaaS or web company.
Strong business judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous questions into clear analytical approaches.
Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large event datasets.
Production dbt experience, including data lineage, DAGs, testing, and CI.
Experience with Git-based workflows, including branches, pull requests, and code reviews.
Experience building decision-oriented dashboards in Looker or a comparable BI platform.
Practical experience using AI agents in analytical or engineering workflows.
A proactive, “can-do” approach, with the communication skills and adaptability required to manage competing priorities and influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
